content: Duniyait naformani bari giyegoi
Ei bafe zehon duniyait manušor šoinkka beši owa šuru goijje edde bout mayafuwain okkol zormo oiye,
toi Allar futain okkole mainšor ziyain okkolore šundor dekiyore, zattu zare issa, hite hibare biya goijje.
Henot Mabude hodde, "Ãr Ruh insanor butore hamiša taki no zaibogoi, kiyollahoile hitara lou edde gustor; hitarar aiyu oibo ekšo kuri bosor."

Hẽtte, edde hiyar bade o duniyait folowan okkol aššil, Allar futain okkole mainšor ziyain okkol loi zehon mille, hitarattu fuwain okkol oiye, hitara zara aššil he furan hailla nam gora beši ḍõr ḍõr bir okkol.
Mabud Allaye sadde, duniyait manušor naformani beši ḍõr, edde hitarar dilor hár sinta bafona hár šomot bolke horafir uzu.
Hetolla, Mabude duniyait manuš banaiyede hiyan loi bezar oiye, edde dile duk faiye.

Toi Mabude hodde, "Ãi ze manuš zati sirišti goijji, hinore duniyaittu fũsi felaiyum; manušottu loti zandar zanuwar foijjonto, buke aṛede zandar edde asmanor tole faik okkolore o; kiyollahoile ãi hitarare sirišti goriyore ãr dile duk far."
Kintu Nuhuye Allar torfottu doya faiye.
Nuh
In oilde Nuhur bongšor kahani. Nuh ekzon forhesgar manuš aššil. He šomot manuš okkolor butore hiba aššilde ekzon haṭi manuš. Nuhuttu Allar loi aza zugazug aššil.
Nuhuttu Šem, Ham edde Yafet name tin fut aššil.
Hẽtte Allar nozorot duniyaigan horaf oigiyegoi edde zai-zulume boriuiṭṭe.
Allaye duniyair mikka saiye, ar so, hiyan horaf oigiyegoi, haron duniyair hár mainše hitarar kufõt giyegoi.
Toi Allaye Nuhure hodde, "Hár zandaror šeš hal ãr sarme aišše, kiyollahoile hitarar duwara duniyai zulume boriuiṭṭe; ar sa, ãi duniyair fũwati hitarare dongšo gorifelaiyum.
Tui gupér gas diyore ekkan zahaz tiyar gor; hiyanor butore kamera okkol goribi, edde hiyanor butore baire kuldar ḍoli dibi.
Endilla gori hiyan tiyar gora foribo: Zahazsan lamba tin šot hat, fatari šoṛa fõnzaš hat, ar hiyan usol oibo tiriš hat.
Ar zahazor sanir ek hat tolottu zanala tiyar goribi edde zahazor ḍakottu doroza rakibi; hiyanor foila, dusora, edde tisera ṭala gori tiyar gora foribo.
Ar sa, asmanor tole zeto ḍoilla zandar niyaš foran loi basi ase, hitara beggun dongšo oibolla ãi duniyait ek fanir tuwan aniyum, Duniyair hár zandar mori zaiboi.
Kintu tor loi ãi ãr wadar sukti buwaiyum. Tui zai zahazot gólibi. Ar tor fũwati tor futain okkol edde tor bou edde tor futaindor bouwain okkol takibo.
Ar lou gustowala zandar miyala modda zura zura tor fũwati zinda takibolla zahazot loibi.
Hár zator faik okkolottu, hár zator zandar zanuwar okkolottu edde hár zator buke aṛede zandar okkolottu foran basaibolla ek ek zura tor hãse aibo.
Tui háibar hár ḍoilla ziniš okkol loi dola gori rakibi. Hin oibode tor edde hitarar haiddo."
Nuhuye hendilla goijje, Allaye hokum dilde mozin hibaye hár kissu goijje.
